items: 【Lightweight Design for Effortless Use】- Weighing only 1.65 lbs, this 8V drill set is designed for comfort and control. Ideal for drilling wood, plastic, and tightening or loosening screws. Its adjustable speed, with a max no-load speed of 800r/min, makes it perfect for both beginners and experienced users.

【Fast Charging for Extended Use】- Equipped with a 1.5Ah rechargeable battery, this tool set offers extended runtime to complete tasks without interruptions. Supports Type-C 1.5A fast charging — fully charges in just 90 minutes for added convenience.

【Durable Tools with Anti-Rust Coating】- All tools feature an anti-rust electroplated coating for lasting durability. Heat-treated chrome plating enhances corrosion resistance, while non-slip TPR handles ensure a secure and comfortable grip.

【Reinforced Toolbox for Secure Storage】- The durable toolbox features reinforced corners and shock-resistant design, ensuring tools stay safe and organized during transportation. Each tool fits securely in its designated slot to prevent movement.

【All-in-One Tool Kit for Daily Repairs】- This 180PCS tool kit is designed to simplify everyday repairs and DIY projects. Perfect for assembling furniture, installing appliances, maintaining your home, or handling minor renovations with ease and confidence.

【Ideal Gift for DIY Enthusiasts & Homeowners】- This practical tool kit makes an excellent gift for men, women, friends, and family. Ideal for Father's Day, Christmas, or as a thoughtful gift for new homeowners and DIY enthusiasts.
